_comment: LTX-2.3 22B distilled, image-to-video WITH NATIVE AUDIO, in ComfyUI API format.
The audio is the point. LTX-2 is an audio-visual model: it generates the
dialogue and the picture together, from the same sampling pass, which is why
the speech is actually in sync rather than dubbed on afterwards. The first
version of this graph decoded only the video half and threw the other away —
everything it produced was silent, and the pipeline's audio policy quietly
reclassified the whole local backend as draft-only because of it.
The AV path, and why each node is here:
audio_latent  LTXVEmptyLatentAudio  an empty audio latent the right length
av            LTXVConcatAVLatent    video + audio into ONE latent, because
the model samples both at once — this is
what makes the mouth match the words
split         LTXVSeparateAVLatent  back into two after sampling
decode_audio  LTXVAudioVAEDecode    audio latent to a waveform
video         CreateVideo           frames + waveform into one VIDEO
save          SaveVideo             muxed mp4, audio included
`sigmas` still takes the VIDEO latent, not the AV one: LTXVScheduler shifts
the noise schedule by token count as a proxy for resolution, and audio tokens
are not resolution. If the picture ever comes back burnt or washed out, this
is the first line to suspect.
To fix any of it: open ComfyUI at :8188, load this, correct it, Export (API),
and save it back over this file. Nothing in the server needs to change.
Distilled defaults: cfg 1.0 and few steps. A distilled model has the guidance
baked in, so running it at cfg 8 like a base model produces burnt, oversaturated
frames — the classic symptom if these numbers are wrong.
